ScheduledPage.title: Scheduled operations
ScheduledPage.description: Deploys, promotions and other changes set to run later. They run as the person or API key that scheduled them, with their access checked again at that time.
ScheduledPage.hint: Schedule from the CLI with --at, e.g. harmoniq promote --module checkout --from staging --to production --at 2026-10-12T09:00:00Z, or with POST /api/workspaces/{workspace}/scheduled-operations.

DependencyMatrix.empty: No module declares dependencies here yet. Deploy with dependencies to see them.
